title: Nvidia invests $5B in Intel common stock

sources.quote: NVIDIA will invest $5 billion in Intel’s common stock at a purchase price of $23.28 per share.

On September 15, 2025, we entered into an agreement to issue and sell 215 million shares of our common stock to NVIDIA at a price of $23.28 per share, representing an aggregate cash purchase price of $5.0 billion.

explain: Nvidia bought $5 billion of newly issued Intel shares (about 215 million shares at $23.28), giving cash-strapped Intel fresh capital. The two also agreed to co-develop data center and PC chips that link Intel CPUs with Nvidia technology. The purchase closed on December 26, 2025.
